subject: Invoice orbit: drawdown rotation and VAT evidence needed
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueorbit.com>, finance@blueorbit.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice orbit: drawdown rotation and VAT evidence needed

Hi Elena / BlueOrbit AP team,

Thanks again for committing to the annual capacity plan. To get the invoicing cadence aligned with your AP process we propose a "drawdown rotation" model (see schedule below). Before we issue the first tranche invoice we need a short VAT evidence bundle and confirmation of remittance details.

Proposed drawdown rotation (high level):
- Tranche 1: 2025-08-12 (covers Aug 12–Sep 11)
- Tranche 2: 2025-09-12 (covers Sep 12–Oct 11)
- Tranche 3: 2025-10-12 (covers Oct 12–Nov 11)
- Then monthly thereafter until the commitment is exhausted or renewed

What we need from your side by EOD Tuesday (2025-08-05):
1) VAT certificate or local tax registration for BlueOrbit (attachment: BlueOrbit_VAT_2025.pdf)
2) Confirm remittance route + bank details and whether you need a PO# on the invoice
3) Any specific invoice header wording or tax text required by local finance

We will:
- Issue a preview invoice (PDF) 5 business days before each tranche
- Bundle VAT evidence in the invoice packet if provided in advance
- Respect your payment terms (please confirm Net-30 vs Net-45)

Attachments referenced: BlueOrbit_VAT_2025.pdf (if available), bank_details_blueorbit.docx (for your AP)

If it's helpful I'd be happy to set a 20-min call Tuesday morning to walk through the rotation and confirm PO flow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: BlueOrbit_VAT_2025.pdf (awaiting), bank_details_blueorbit.docx

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueorbit.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, finance@blueorbit.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice orbit: drawdown rotation and VAT evidence needed

Hi Kimberly — thanks, this looks good.

We can support the proposed rotation. A few notes from procurement/AP:
- BlueOrbit will pay Net-30.
- We will provide VAT registration and a letter confirming our VAT status (attached: BO_VAT_2025.pdf).
- Our AP team prefers the invoice to reference PO# BO-PO-7782; please include it in the invoice header.
- Bank remittance: Attached bank remit file (blueorbit_remit.txt).

I'll ask AP to process the first tranche payment target on or shortly after 2025-08-18 once the preview invoice is approved. If you could send the preview invoice by 2025-08-12 that gives our team time to route internally.

Quick Q: Do you need an EU VAT agent form or just the registration PDF? We can provide both if necessary.

Cheers,
Elena Torres
Director, Procurement — BlueOrbit
Attachment stubs: BO_VAT_2025.pdf, blueorbit_remit.txt

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueorbit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice orbit: drawdown rotation and VAT evidence needed

Thanks Elena — that's perfect and exactly the timing we needed. Two quick operational asks:

1) Please confirm whether the VAT PDF includes your company registration number as shown on the attached (helps Jordan & tax team match records).
2) We'll include PO# BO-PO-7782 on all tranche invoices — please confirm if the PO needs a specific account code on the invoice line items.

Jordan — can you prepare the preview invoice for Tranche 1 (2025-08-12) and include a VAT section that references BO_VAT_2025.pdf? I put Marissa here to keep AE/bookkeeping aligned.

If anyone prefers a quick sync, I'm free Tue 12:00–12:30.

Best,
Kimberly
Attachment stubs: None

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueorbit.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2025 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Preview invoice: INV-REDWOOD-BO-202508 (for review)

Hi all,

I've attached the preview invoice for Tranche 1 (INV-REDWOOD-BO-202508.pdf). Highlights/notes:
- Total tranche amount: USD 120,000 (monthly-equivalent drawdown)
- Invoice date: 2025-08-12
- Due date (Net-30): 2025-09-11
- PO: BO-PO-7782 included in header as requested
- VAT handling: We will apply standard VAT line and reference the provided BO_VAT_2025.pdf in the invoice packet. Tax has been coded to the US region. If BlueOrbit needs reverse-charge text for EU jurisdictions please advise and we'll add the clause.

Attachments: INV-REDWOOD-BO-202508.pdf (preview), VAT_bundle_for_AP.zip (contains BO_VAT_2025.pdf and tax-statement.txt)

Kimberly — I recommend we run the drawdown rotation as weekly pulls of the tranche amount across two scheduled settlements to spread risk (example schedule included in the invoice PDF). Let me know if you'd rather have a single settlement date.

Elena — can you confirm AP will accept the single PDF packet + VAT bundle? If yes I will mark the invoice as ready and schedule the electronic send on Aug 12.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: INV-REDWOOD-BO-202508.pdf, VAT_bundle_for_AP.zip

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueorbit.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, finance@blueorbit.com
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preview invoice: INV-REDWOOD-BO-202508 (for review)

Jordan / Kimberly — confirmed.

AP will accept the single PDF packet with the VAT bundle attached. We will schedule payment processing for the tranche on 2025-08-18 and expect funds to clear per Net-30 terms (on or before 2025-09-11).

We're attaching a short remittance confirmation after the first settlement to close the loop. If anything changes on our side I'll flag it immediately.

Thanks for the clear process — this invoice-orbit approach should make monthly reconciles much easier.

Best,
Elena Torres
Director, Procurement — BlueOrbit
Attachment stubs: blueorbit_remit_confirmation_20250818.pdf
